label: shrine40
title_zh: 太阳，和它全部有毒的光芒

lines.en: label shrine40:
scene noonsky
There is naught to do in summer but bathe in the muggy omnipotence of its tangible, suffocating humidity- so thick that I can feel it embracing me as I make my way up a familiar set of stairs.
lines.zh: 夏天无事可做，只能泡在它那闷热黏腻、令人窒息的湿度的全能统治里——它浓稠到我在爬上那段熟悉的台阶时，都能感觉到它正拥抱着我。

lines.en: I can see distorted lines in the air from where it has gotten confused, and I do my best to look past them as making them even more self-conscious would not bode well for the weather.
lines.zh: 我能看见空气里因为热得糊涂而扭曲的纹路，我尽量不看它们，因为让它们变得更不自在，对天气来说可不是什么好兆头。

lines.en: If you’re wondering what I’m talking about, you’re not alone. For thoughts like these have been plaguing me for thirty minutes as I’ve become fed up with this mid-year glow and all it means for Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: 如果你在好奇我到底在说什么，那你不是一个人。因为这样的念头已经折磨我三十分钟了——我受够了这个年中才有的灼热，以及它对 Kumon-mi 意味着的一切。

lines.en: Soon enough, the cold will return — and with it will come the death of something that never should have been in the first place.
lines.zh: 很快，寒冷就会回来——随之而来的，是某样从一开始就不该存在的东西的死亡。

lines.en: The sun, and all its toxic rays.
lines.zh: 太阳，和它全部有毒的光芒。

lines.en: scene black
The distorted shape of summer tapers off along with the last of the stairs as something else comes into my line of sight.
lines.zh: 随着最后一级台阶走完，夏天扭曲的形状也渐渐收束，另一样东西进入了我的视线。

lines.en: scene mayanemaiden1
Can you see it too?
lines.zh: 你也看得见吗？

lines.en: Or does the appearance of something you’re unable to explain hurt you more than any amount of the heat’s embrace ever could?
lines.zh: 还是说，某种你无法解释的东西出现在眼前，带给你的伤害比多少酷热的拥抱都要深？

lines.en: : Is something wrong, Maya?
lines.zh: : 出什么事了吗，Maya？

lines.en: : Something is always wrong.
lines.zh: : 什么时候都出着什么事。

lines.en: : It’s hot, this dress is heavier than it looks, and to complicate things even more, {i}you’re{/i} here now.
lines.zh: : 天很热，这条裙子比看上去重得多，而且让事情更复杂的是——{i}你{/i}现在也在这儿。

lines.en: : I can leave if you want.
lines.zh: : 你想的话我可以走。

lines.en: : Okay. See you.
lines.zh: : 好啊。再见。

lines.en: : Actually, I think I’ll stay.
lines.zh: : 其实，我想我还是留下吧。

lines.en: : It’s extremely irritating how your existence continues to...{i}irritate{/i} me even after the most...{i}irritating{/i} parts of it have gone away.
lines.zh: : 真是恼人得要命——就算你身上最……{i}恼人{/i}的部分已经消失了，你的存在还是照样在……{i}恼我{/i}。

lines.en: : I’m starting to think you might be irritated.
lines.zh: : 我开始觉得你可能是被恼到了。

lines.en: : Shut up. It’s hot.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴。天太热了。

lines.en: It’s funny to think of how little things have changed after all we’ve been through.
lines.zh: 想想看还挺好笑的——我们经历了那么多，事情却几乎没什么变化。

lines.en: In fact, I feel like most of my early conversations here were just like this.
lines.zh: 事实上，我觉得我早期在这儿的大部分对话都是这个样子。

lines.en: I’d show up out of nowhere, seek out a young girl a full foot shorter than me, and then promptly ruin her day because something about annoying her made me feel a little more human.
lines.zh: 我会突然冒出来，找一个比我矮整整一英尺的年轻女孩，然后立刻毁掉她的一天，因为惹她生气不知怎么让我觉得自己更像个人。

lines.en: Just being around her now has that effect.
lines.zh: 光是现在待在她身边就有这种效果。

lines.en: And even when she looks at me like that, in complete disregard for all the two of us have gone through-
lines.zh: 即便她那样看着我——完全不顾我们两个人共同经历过的一切——

lines.en: I want nothing more than to remove her dress, carry her back to my room, and make her cry out my name.
lines.zh: 我也只想把她的裙子脱掉，把她抱回我的房间，让她喊出我的名字。

lines.en: My real name.
lines.zh: 我的真名。

lines.en: : Can you save your disgusting, lustful glares for when I am {i}not{/i} melting? Thanks.
lines.zh: : 你能不能把你那恶心又色眯眯的眼神留到我{i}没有{/i}在融化的时候？谢了。

lines.en: : My room has air conditioning, you know.
lines.zh: : 我房间有空调，你知道的。

lines.en: scene mayanemaiden2
: Okay, so I guess that’s a “no.” Wonderful.
lines.zh: : 好，那我猜这就是“不行”了。真好。

lines.en: : Wonderful indeed. So, are you ready to talk about that thing I said to you on the beach? Or are we really going to keep ignoring it?
lines.zh: : 确实很好。那么，你准备好谈谈我在海滩上跟你说过的那件事了吗？还是我们真要一直装作没这回事？

lines.en: : Now is...really not the time for that.
lines.zh: : 现在……真的不是时候。

lines.en: : Any reason why? Or are you just continuing to avoid me because it makes things more convenient and-
lines.zh: : 有什么原因吗？还是你只是继续躲着我，因为这样对你更方便，然后——

lines.en: : Sensei!
lines.zh: : Sensei！

lines.en: scene mayanemaiden3
: Oh, okay. I get it now.
lines.zh: : 哦，好吧。我懂了。

lines.en: : Just kill me already. I’m starting to miss the more peaceful cycles from before I had {i}feelings{/i} and {i}bonds{/i} I had to worry about.
lines.zh: : 干脆杀了我算了。我开始怀念以前那些平静的循环了——在我还得操心什么{i}感情{/i}和{i}羁绊{/i}之前。

lines.en: : Thanks for having tons of sex with me the other day! I had a great time!
lines.zh: : 谢谢你那天跟我做了那么多次爱！我玩得很开心！

lines.en: : And that. That might be the worst part of all.
lines.zh: : 还有这个。这个说不定是最糟的部分。

lines.en: : Ayane, let’s not talk about what we do in our free time around...literally anyone else. Let alone at a- wait, why are you also a shrine maiden all of a sudden?
lines.zh: : Ayane，我们别在任何人面前聊我们空闲时间做的事好吗。更别说还是在个——等等，你怎么突然也变成巫女了？

lines.en: scene mayanemaiden4
: Because she’s starting to become just as obsessed with {i}me{/i} as she is with you. Thanks for that.
lines.zh: : 因为她开始变得跟对你一样迷恋{i}我{/i}了。多谢你了。

lines.en: : How is that my fault? Ayane got attached to you on her own and I had nothing to do with it.
lines.zh: : 这怎么怪我了？Ayane 是自己黏上你的，跟我一点关系都没有。

lines.en: : You had a little bit to do with it.
lines.zh: : 多少有一点关系。

lines.en: : You’re not helping. And that still doesn’t explain where you got the dress or why you’re here instead of the dojo.
lines.zh: : 你没帮上忙。而且这还是没解释你从哪儿弄来的裙子，以及你为什么在这儿而不是在道场。

lines.en: : I gave her the dress, obviously.
lines.zh: : 裙子是我给她的，显然。

lines.en: : Well, no wonder she’s obsessed with you. You’re giving her free stuff. Be more like me if you want her to go away. I never give her anything.
lines.zh: : 难怪她那么迷恋你。你在白送她东西。想让她离你远点就该学学我。我什么都不给她。

lines.en: : That’s not true. You give me {i}that dick{/i} all the time.
lines.zh: : 才怪。你可是天天把{i}那根鸡巴{/i}给我。

lines.en: scene mayanemaiden5
: Didn’t I ask you to sweep the inside of the shrine?
lines.zh: : 我不是让你去扫神社里面吗？

lines.en: : I finished up as quickly as I could when I heard Sensei’s footsteps coming up the stairs.
lines.zh: : 我一听到 Sensei 上台阶的脚步声，就尽快做完了。

lines.en: : Well...go do it again. It’s distracting having to listen to you brag about your sex life all day now that you’re no longer practicing abstinence.
lines.zh: : 那……再去扫一遍。你既然不再禁欲了，整天听你炫耀性生活，很让人分心。

lines.en: : Can someone please explain to me why Ayane is a shrine maiden now or are we going to keep annoying Maya instead?
lines.zh: : 谁能给我解释一下 Ayane 为什么现在是巫女了？还是说我们要继续把 Maya 惹毛？

lines.en: : I’m fine with the latter, I just don’t know what level of seriousness we’re going for today.
lines.zh: : 后者我无所谓，我只是不知道今天我们要走哪个认真程度。

lines.en: scene mayanemaiden6
: Hah...
: The reason I gave her the dress and the reason I’m having her tidy up the shrine is because it seemed like the most...practical option considering her newfound interest in my daily routine.
lines.zh: : 我给她裙子、让她帮忙打扫神社，是因为考虑到她最近对我日常作息产生的新兴趣，这看起来是最实用的选择。

lines.en: : I figured that if she’s going to be hanging around here, I should at least have her {i}work{/i} so our time is not entirely wasted.
lines.zh: : 我想，既然她要一直在这儿晃，那我至少该让她{i}干活{/i}，这样我们的时间才不算完全浪费。

lines.en: : Me working here means that we get to talk about more reset-stuff too.
lines.zh: : 我在这儿干活，意味着我们还能多聊些重置相关的事。

lines.en: : And since nobody else ever really shows up, we don’t have to worry about some other girl from class appearing at the wrong time and thinking we’re plotting a takeover of the universe or something.
lines.zh: : 而且反正平时也没别人来，我们就不用担心班上哪个女生在不对的时间冒出来，以为我们在策划接管宇宙什么的。

lines.en: : I think there’s a higher likelihood that someone like that would just interrupt us, but I suppose that’s not really important right now.
lines.zh: : 我觉得那种人更可能直接打断我们，不过我想这不重要。

lines.en: scene mayanemaiden7
: At the end of the day, I see minimal harm in taking on an apprentice if that apprentice is going to actually {i}work.{/i} Plus, having someone to brainstorm with is also a bit of a bonus.
lines.zh: : 说到底，收个徒弟如果那徒弟真会{i}干活{/i}，我看也没什么坏处。再说，有个人一起动动脑子也算是个额外的好处。

lines.en: : We can chalk Ayane’s new role up to just...formal inclusion and proof of her new place in this never-ending timeline.
lines.zh: : Ayane 的新角色，就当是……正式的收编，以及她在这条永不终结的时间线里新位置的证明吧。

lines.en: : Phase one, rooftop apocalypse buddy! Phase two, coworker-slash-shrine maiden buddy!
lines.zh: : 第一阶段，天台末日搭档！第二阶段，同事兼巫女搭档！

lines.en: : What’s phase three?
lines.zh: : 第三阶段是什么？

lines.en: scene mayanemaiden8
: A bride!
lines.zh: : 新娘！

lines.en: : Did you really have to ask?
lines.zh: : 你非得问吗？

lines.en: : Mine? Or Maya’s? Because the other two phases both involved her.
lines.zh: : 我的新娘？还是 Maya 的？因为前两个阶段都跟她有关。

lines.en: scene mayanemaiden9
: I don’t like girls. But Maya is cute and I’d probably marry her for tax purposes if I make it to twenty and Sensei still doesn’t-
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢女生。但 Maya 很可爱，要是我能活到二十岁、Sensei 还没——我大概会为了避税跟她结婚。

lines.en: : Rejected.
lines.zh: : 驳回。

lines.en: : Oh well. My family’s rich and I probably won’t even have to pay taxes anyway. But if you change your mind and-
lines.zh: : 好吧。反正我家有钱，我大概连税都不用交。不过如果你改变主意，然后——

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不行。

lines.en: : You tried, Ayane. And that’s all you can really do with Maya.
lines.zh: : 你努力过了，Ayane。面对 Maya，你能做的也就只有这些了。

lines.en: : I’ll get her to love me one day. I can feel it.
lines.zh: : 总有一天我会让她爱上我的。我感觉得到。

lines.en: : So, is this just...what you two do now? Hang out at a shrine and talk about time travel?
lines.zh: : 那么，这就是……你们俩现在的日常吗？泡在神社里聊时间旅行？

lines.en: : That’s not much different from what I usually do. The only substantial change is that I now have to hear about how great you are every five minutes.
lines.zh: : 跟我平时做的也没多大区别。唯一实质性的变化是，我现在每五分钟就得听一遍你有多好。

lines.en: : I’m sure I’ll work up an immunity to it sooner or later like I have with basically everything else.
lines.zh: : 我迟早会像对其他一切事情一样，对这件事也产生免疫力的。

lines.en: : Hey, if getting involved in the resets is all it took to land me a job here, does that mean everyone {i}else{/i} gets to become a shrine maiden too if they all wind up making it to the roof?
lines.zh: : 嘿，如果卷进重置就能让我在这儿谋到份差事，那是不是说，要是{i}其他{/i}人也都上了天台，就都能当巫女？

lines.en: : This is a question I take personal interest in, so I’d like to hear an answer to this as well.
lines.zh: : 这个问题我个人很有兴趣，所以我也想听听答案。

lines.en: scene mayanemaiden10
: Ayane, {i}please{/i} don’t forget that this whole thing with you is some strange fluke and that the likelihood of anyone {i}else{/i} getting roped into this reset business is basically zero.
lines.zh: : Ayane，{i}拜托{/i}别忘了，你这件事纯粹是个异数，{i}其他{/i}任何人被卷进重置这档子事的概率基本为零。

lines.en: : Right, yeah. Because you haven’t gotten any other prediction wrong so far. I forgot about that.
lines.zh: : 对，是啊。毕竟你到目前为止一个预言都没出错嘛。我忘了。

lines.en: : Please don’t make me regret the decision to let you get closer to me in sheer physical proximity only with zero room for substantial emotional attachment.
lines.zh: : 别让我后悔这个决定——允许你在物理距离上靠近我，但在情感依恋上一点余地都不留。

lines.en: : Aww, I love you too.
lines.zh: : 啊，我也爱你。

lines.en: : What if someone else {i}does{/i} make it up there, though?
lines.zh: : 可要是{i}真{/i}有别人上去了呢？

lines.en: scene mayanemaiden11
: Are you only asking because you want to see {i}them{/i} in the dress as well?
lines.zh: : 你问这个，该不会只是想看{i}她们{/i}也穿上那条裙子吧？

lines.en: : No. I’m asking for the sake of the universe. But the dress part does help.
lines.zh: : 不是。我是为了宇宙着想。不过裙子那部分确实加分。

lines.en: scene noonsky
: Ugh...I guess that’s just one more bridge we’ll have to figure out how to cross if we ever manage to make it there.
lines.zh: : 呃……好吧，那也不过是又一座桥，等我们真走到那儿再想办法过就是了。

lines.en: : For now, I think it would be best if we were to come up with some sort of gameplan on what we want to accomplish {i}this{/i} cycle.
lines.zh: : 眼下，我觉得我们最好针对{i}这个{/i}循环想出某种行动计划，明确我们想达成什么。

lines.en: : During the last one, we discovered that it is not entirely impossible for others to gain some sort of awareness as well. Which would mean that {i}this{/i} time-
lines.zh: : 上一个循环里，我们发现其他人也获得某种意识并非完全不可能。也就是说{i}这{/i}一次——

lines.en: : We need to test that theory again, right?
lines.zh: : 我们得再验证一遍那个理论，对吧？

lines.en: scene mayanemaiden12
: Uhh...yes, actually. But how did you know I was going to say that?
lines.zh: : 呃……对，没错。可你怎么知道我要说这个？

lines.en: : Because I’ve been secretly traveling through time longer than you and know everything that is going to happen from this point onward.
lines.zh: : 因为我偷偷穿越的时间比你久，从现在开始往后会发生什么我都知道。

lines.en: : Spoiler alert, I end up with Sensei.
lines.zh: : 剧透警告，最后是我和 Sensei 在一起。

lines.en: : Sure, but how did you {i}actually-{/i}
lines.zh: : 行，可你{i}到底{/i}是怎么——

lines.en: : Because it’s the same thing you did last time with the whole pregnancy thing.
lines.zh: : 因为上次那个怀孕的事你就是这么干的。

lines.en: : You came up with a theory and decided to spend the entirety of the last cycle {i}testing{/i} that theory and inflicting a great deal of suffering on both Sensei {i}and{/i} me.
lines.zh: : 你提出一个理论，然后决定把整个上一個循环都用来{i}验证{/i}那个理论，顺便给 Sensei{i}和{/i}我造成大量痛苦。

lines.en: : It’s not really science if things happen only one time, so experiments like this are good for when you want to prove that something wasn’t just a fluke.
lines.zh: : 如果事情只发生过一次，那算不上真正的科学，所以这种实验很适合用来证明某件事不只是个巧合。

lines.en: : Which is, surprisingly enough, a thing you directly contradicted by calling {i}me{/i} a fluke a few minutes ago.
lines.zh: : 而这一点，说来也讽刺，恰恰被你几分钟前把{i}我{/i}称作异数给直接推翻了。

lines.en: : But hey, if you want to only believe in certain things when they make you sound smarter then, by all means, proceed.
lines.zh: : 不过嘛，如果你只想在某些能让你显得更聪明的时候才相信某些事，那请便。

lines.en: : You know, you spend so much time being absolutely unbearable that I forget how smart you really are sometimes.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，你长时间以来都让人难以忍受，以至于我有时会忘记你其实有多聪明。

lines.en: : I know. I’m a real catch, aren’t I?
lines.zh: : 我知道。我是个不可多得的好女人，对吧？

lines.en: scene mayanemaiden13
: What Ayane said just now was right.
lines.zh: : Ayane 刚才说的有一句是对的。

lines.en: : The...part about her being a catch?
lines.zh: : ……说她自己不可多得那句？

lines.en: : Sensei already knows that. You don’t have to remind him.
lines.zh: : 那句 Sensei 早就知道了。不用你提醒他。

lines.en: : Not that part. The part about needing to test this theory of other girls catching onto the resets.
lines.zh: : 不是那句。是需要验证“其他女孩也会察觉到重置”这个理论那句。

lines.en: : It didn’t happen until very late in the cycle last time, so if we can manage to convince someone we’re not completely insane a little {i}earlier{/i} this time, we might have better luck finding something out.
lines.zh: : 上次直到循环很后期才发生，所以如果我们这次能{i}更早{/i}一点说服某个人、证明我们不是彻头彻尾的疯子，说不定运气会好些，能查出点什么。

lines.en: : Okay...but then what?
lines.zh: : 好……然后呢？

lines.en: : Then...we know more things. It’s called {i}learning.{/i} As a teacher, this information should be invaluable to you.
lines.zh: : 然后……我们就知道更多事了。这叫{i}学习{/i}。作为一名老师，这个信息对你来说应该很宝贵。

lines.en: : What Maya means to say is that if we learn things quickly enough, you might get a {i}third{/i} shrine maiden soon.
lines.zh: : Maya 的意思是，如果我们学得够快，你很快就能有{i}第三{/i}个巫女了。

lines.en: : That I can understand and it is something I will strive for. Thank you, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 这个我听得懂，也是我会努力的方向。谢谢你，Ayane。

lines.en: : Don’t mention it.
lines.zh: : 不客气。

lines.en: : Can you maybe attempt having some sort of drive that {i}doesn’t{/i} pertain to young girls in costumes in the future? Or is this just what I’ve signed up for?
lines.zh: : 你以后能不能试着找点{i}不{/i}跟穿着戏服的年轻女孩有关的动力？还是说我签下的就是这么一份合同？

lines.en: : If anyone should know, I think it should be you.
lines.zh: : 要说谁该清楚这一点，我觉得应该是你。

lines.en: : It is. I was just looking for a little false encouragement as it might make this terrible day slightly more bearable for a few minutes.
lines.zh: : 是的。我只是想讨一句假的鼓励，好让这糟糕的一天能有那么几分钟稍微好熬一点。

lines.en: : Then I will do it for science.
lines.zh: : 那我就为了科学而说吧。

lines.en: scene mayanemaiden14
: Ugh, forget it. You’re a terrible liar and asking someone as self-serving and incompetent as you to do anything just makes {i}me{/i} look like an idiot.
lines.zh: : 唉，算了。你撒谎的本事烂透了，而{i}我{/i}拜托一个像你这样自私又没用的人去做任何事，只会让我看起来像个白痴。

lines.en: : Is there anyone you have in mind as a {i}target?{/i} Should we try our luck with Yumi and Tsuneyo again? Maybe see if they have some...lingering memories from the last reset or something?
lines.zh: : 你心里有{i}目标{/i}人选吗？我们要不要在 Yumi 和 Tsuneyo 身上再碰碰运气？看看她们有没有……上个重置留下的记忆什么的？

lines.en: : I...{i}attempted{/i} speaking with Tsuneyo on my own, but I think it’s safe to say she doesn’t remember anything. As far as Yumi goes...I’d rather not approach her.
lines.zh: : 我……{i}试过{/i}单独跟 Tsuneyo 谈，不过我想可以肯定地说，她什么都不记得。至于 Yumi 嘛……我更不想去接近她。

lines.en: : I can talk to Yumi. That would probably go a little better than either of you-
lines.zh: : Yumi 我可以说。那大概会比你们俩谁去都顺利一点——

lines.en: : What about Ami?
lines.zh: : 那 Ami 呢？

lines.en: scene mayanemaiden15
: Ami?
lines.zh: : Ami？

lines.en: : Yeah! She’s the closest to us out of everyone and I’m sure she’d be open to hearing us out. Especially since it’ll help her feel less excluded and stuff.
lines.zh: : 对呀！她是所有人里跟我们最亲近的，我敢肯定她会愿意听我们说。而且这样还能让她觉得自己没被排除在外什么的。

lines.en: : She might think we’re a little crazy at first, but she’s gullible enough to start believing us if we keep pressing her about it.
lines.zh: : 一开始她可能会觉得我们有点疯，但她够好骗，只要我们一直追着她讲，她迟早会信的。

lines.en: : Ami’s not a good idea, Ayane.
lines.zh: : Ami 不是个好主意，Ayane。

lines.en: scene mayanemaiden16
: She’s not? Why?
lines.zh: : 不是吗？为什么？

lines.en: : It’s...a long and complicated story.
lines.zh: : 这……说来话长，很复杂。

lines.en: : I mean...I don’t have anything else going on. You can tell me about it if you want.
lines.zh: : 我是说……我也没什么别的事。你想说的话可以告诉我啊。

lines.en: : I’m afraid the story is far too long and far too complicated to just {i}tell{/i} you. I wouldn’t be recounting some tale of how I was banned from a convenience store or anything like that.
lines.zh: : 只怕这个故事太长太复杂，不是光靠{i}讲{/i}就能讲完的。我又不是在讲什么我被便利店拉黑之类的轶事。

lines.en: : I’d be describing probably decades or...centuries of trying that exact thing to no avail as I thought the same thing as you.
lines.zh: : 我要讲的，大概是我怀着和你一模一样的想法，把同一件事尝试了几十年……甚至几百年，却毫无结果。

lines.en: : And not only did it never work, it made her...mad.
lines.zh: : 而且它不仅从来没成功过，还让她……发火了。

lines.en: : It’s just not worth the effort.
lines.zh: : 不值得费那个劲。

lines.en: : Ami? Mad? But if it doesn’t involve Sensei, she basically never gets mad. And Sensei wasn’t a recurring thing for this until a couple cycles ago, right?
lines.zh: : Ami？发火？可只要不牵扯到 Sensei，她基本上从不生气啊。而且 Sensei 是几个循环之前才成为常驻因素的吧？

lines.en: : Yes and...no. That’s also a little too complicated to just casually recount.
lines.zh: : 是，也……不是。那也有点太复杂，没法随口讲清。

lines.en: scene mayanemaiden17
: Well...we can sideline the Ami thing for now and maybe talk more about that later. I can tell by that face that this might be a touchy subject for you.
lines.zh: : 那……Ami 的事我们可以先放一放，以后再细聊。看你的表情我就知道，这对你可能是个敏感话题。

lines.en: : Thank you. I think Yumi remains our strongest prospect for the moment, but I’m sure there are other names that might pop up as this iteration of the school year goes by.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。我认为目前 Yumi 仍是我们最有力的人选，不过我敢肯定，随着这一轮的学年推进，还会冒出别的名字。

lines.en: scene mayanemaiden18
: What matters most is that we do {i}something.{/i} Time itself might be infinite, but who knows if {i}ours{/i} is?
lines.zh: : 最重要的是我们得做点{i}什么{/i}。时间本身也许是无限的，可谁知道{i}我们的{/i}时间是不是呢？

lines.en: : Understood?
lines.zh: : 明白了吗？

lines.en: : Yes, captain. Just tell me what to do and I’ll do it.
lines.zh: : 明白，长官。你让我做什么我就做什么。

lines.en: : Excellent. Go away.
lines.zh: : 很好。走吧。

lines.en: scene noonsky
: Got it.
lines.zh: : 收到。

lines.en: : Wha-
: Did that...actually work?
lines.zh: : 这……真的管用了？

lines.en: : Maya! You can’t just send our boyfriend away like that! He’s sensitive!
lines.zh: : Maya！你不能就这么把我们的男朋友支走啊！他很敏感的！

lines.en: : Our {i}what?{/i} Shouldn’t you be sweeping?
lines.zh: : 我们的{i}什么{/i}？你不该去扫地吗？

lines.en: : Sensei! Wait for me! I’ll love you when she can’t!
lines.zh: : Sensei！等等我！她不爱你的时候我来爱你！

lines.en: Ayane chases after me as I go to leave, but is promptly grabbed by the collar as Maya drags her back under the protection of whatever god resides here.
lines.zh: 我正要离开，Ayane 追了出来，但随即被 Maya 一把揪住后领，拖回了住在这儿的某位神明的庇护之下。

lines.en: I’m not leaving because I was told to, but I’m sure you probably understand that based on my {i}history{/i} here.
lines.zh: 我不是因为被人赶才走的，不过基于我在这儿的{i}前科{/i}，你大概也清楚这一点。

lines.en: It’s just far too disgusting out here today and...
lines.zh: 只是今天外面实在太恶心了，而且……

lines.en: And staring so long at something I can not have hurts me more than any amount of the heat’s embrace ever could.
lines.zh: 而盯着某样我得不到的东西看那么久，带给我的伤害比多少酷热的拥抱都要深。

lines.en: scene black
This cycle will melt the wax of my wings.
lines.zh: 这个循环会融化我翅膀上的蜡。

lines.en: I’m flying too close to the sun.
lines.zh: 我飞得离太阳太近了。

{i}Maya’s affection has increased to [maya_love]!{/i}

lines.zh: {i}Ayane 的好感度提升到了 [ayane_love]!{/i}
